title: Avatar upload fails on SDK 3.10.4 when no avatar tags are set
error_signature: tags must be an array: null, tags must be a string: 'null'
symptom: Avatar test builds succeed, but the actual upload fails while creating/updating the avatar metadata.
trigger: Upload an avatar with VRChat SDK 3.10.4 without setting any avatar tag.
root_cause: The forum identifies this as a known SDK 3.10.4 bug in the tags upload path.
solution: Set at least one avatar tag before uploading. The linked VRChat Feedback report marks the bug as available in a future release.
workaround: Set any avatar tag before upload.

title: Quest avatar build fails until Android Build Support is reinstalled
error_signature: Error building Player because scripts had compiler errors
symptom: The same project can build for Windows but Android/Quest builds fail, including VRChat's example avatar in a new project.
trigger: Build the avatar for Android while the local Unity Android Build Support installation is in the failing state documented by the thread.
root_cause: The field report isolates the Android Build Support installation state: Android builds failed even for the SDK example avatar, and reinstalling the module resolved the failure.
solution: Reinstall Android Build Support for Unity 2022.3.22f1 in Unity Hub, then retry the Android build.

title: Contact Receiver Box Size is dropped when a package is imported before SDK 3.10.4
symptom: A Box-shaped VRC Contact Receiver loses its Size value after a package is imported into an older SDK project and that project is later upgraded.
trigger: Import a package containing Box Contact Receiver data into an SDK version that does not recognize the Box fields, then upgrade to SDK 3.10.4 or later.
root_cause: VRChat staff explains that Unity drops serialized component data that the installed SDK version does not recognize; Box contacts became available in SDK 3.10.4.
solution: Upgrade to SDK 3.10.4 or later before importing the package. If it was already imported into an older SDK, re-import it after upgrading.

title: Incomplete failed avatar state can keep later avatar uploads from completing
symptom: Avatar upload does not complete after Avatar Uploading and Signature Uploading; a failed avatar may remain visible on the website but unavailable in VRChat.
trigger: Retry uploads while an earlier avatar upload remains in an incomplete/inconsistent server-side state.
root_cause: The reporter's final resolution identifies an inconsistency associated with an avatar that had not finished uploading.
solution: Delete the failed/incomplete avatar entry and retry the upload.

title: Second and later local world test clients can freeze on a black screen
symptom: During local multi-client world testing, the second and subsequent clients can freeze on a black screen; some rejoin attempts can also crash repeatedly.
trigger: Launch multiple local Build & Test clients for the same world.
workaround: Set VRChat debug logging to Full; a related report's workaround is confirmed by a commenter on this tracked report.

title: VRC Constraint can throw MissingReferenceException after a monitored PhysBone is removed
error_signature: MissingReferenceException: The object of type 'VRCPhysBone' has been destroyed but you are still trying to access it.
symptom: Enabling objects, prefab override operations, undo/redo, or related editor actions can repeatedly throw MissingReferenceException from VRCConstraintBase when stale PhysBone references remain.
trigger: A VRC Constraint has monitored a PhysBone that is later removed, leaving missing references in its monitored PhysBones data.
workaround: Inspect the constraint in Debug mode for missing monitored PhysBone references; recreating the affected constraint clears the stale reference in the reported workflow.
